{{Quote|The Coynite should no longer be a problem for us in the Dathomir system. Without their flagship they will have no staging point to continue their activities. You've completed your mission to the Emperor's satisfaction. Here is your duty pay.|Grand Inquisitor Ja'ce Yiaso|<ref name="SWG" />}}
[[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] '''Ja'ce Yiaso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] who could be found inside the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By circa [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he had an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE pilot]] drive [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] out of the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]].<ref name="SWG" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|A willing mind? How refreshing. I was getting so tired of the standard military pilots. Such wastes. But I suppose they do have their uses...they are nice fodder for the war effort. Don't you agree?|Ja'ce Yiaso to a TIE Pilot|<ref name="SWG" />}}
[[File:Yiasospeak.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Ja'ce Yiaso issues orders to a [[TIE pilot]].]]
Ja'ce Yiaso viewed most pilots as insufferable. Thinking of them as wastes and not realizing that true power lay within the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] and those who understood that. Despite that, he admitted that they had their uses as fodder. He found minds willing to obey him refreshing compared to the standard military pilots. Yiaso found himself uneasy at the reports he had heard about the Coynite pirates at the Dathomir system. Inquisitor [[Vrke]] warned a TIE pilot he was training to be the best in the Imperial Navy to not disappoint Yiaso otherwise they would find themselves under question very quickly. Ja'ce would attempt to understand his foe's, though this did not always work out to his expectation and would find himself impressed at his foe's abilities if he underestimated them.<ref name="SWG" />

Ja'ce held deep respect for those high up in the Empire and seen by the Emperor, such as [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Nial Declann]]. So much so that he found jokes about them to not be amusing. On one occasion he said that even he would not be so foolish to joke about Nial. Even going so far as to warn a TIE Pilot that if they made a joke about Nial again that they may find themselves back at the Emperor's Retreat to answer more questions. Yiaso would warn other imperials to remember that they were loyal to the Empire, otherwise even a Grand Admiral wouldn't be able to protect them from him.<ref name="SWG" />
